loc-1763500317740-jheuuhxkp.name: Ice Planet Xylos

dna.looks: Vast, desolate landscapes dominated by ice and snow, with towering glaciers and occasional stark rock formations. The sky is often filled with ethereal auroral displays. Life, where it exists, is adapted to extreme cold.
dna.colorsAndLighting: A predominantly cool color palette of blues, whites, and greys. Lighting is often diffused and dim, punctuated by the vibrant, shifting colors of the aurora or the stark glare of ice.
dna.atmosphere: Extremely cold and thin atmosphere. Visibility can be poor due to blizzards and pervasive mist or fog. The air carries a biting chill and the stillness of a frozen world.
dna.materials: Dominated by ice, snow, and frost-covered rock. Any manufactured structures would be heavily weathered and show signs of extreme cold degradation.
dna.mood: Isolated, harsh, and awe-inspiring. A sense of grand scale and formidable natural power pervades the environment.
dna.sounds: Wind howling, ice cracking, distant creaks, muffled thuds, faint hums.
dna.spatialLayout: Expansive, open plains, deep valleys, and imposing mountain ranges. Settlements or points of interest are often few and far between, dictated by geothermal activity or strategic positioning.
dna.fauna_base: thick-furred predators, ice-burrowing creatures, adapted avians

loc-1763500317740-jheuuhxkp.searchDesc: A frozen planet with vast snowfields, glacial mountains, and auroral skies.

c14dd0ac-c3cc-4a36-b5ca-6c55dac95a9f.name: Frozen Tundra

dna.looks: Vast, undulating plains covered in deep snowdrifts, punctuated by exposed rocky outcrops and sparse, hardy vegetation. The horizon is often blurred by mist and blowing snow.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by muted greys and whites from the snow and overcast sky, with occasional dark browns or greens from exposed rock and vegetation. Light is soft and diffused, making shadows indistinct.
dna.atmosphere: Bitterly cold and dry, with constant, biting winds that whip snow into blizzards. Visibility is often severely limited by fog and blowing snow, creating a sense of being lost.
dna.materials: Primarily packed snow and ice, with exposed, weathered rock. Any organic matter is frozen and brittle.
dna.mood: Bleak, isolating, and challenging. A sense of endurance and struggle against the elements.
dna.sounds: Wind whistling, snow crunching, distant groans of shifting ice, occasional animal cries.
dna.spatialLayout: Open, featureless expanses that stretch to the horizon, with subtle variations in elevation due to snowdrifts and occasional rocky terrain.

c14dd0ac-c3cc-4a36-b5ca-6c55dac95a9f.searchDesc: Windswept, snow-covered plains with sparse life and frequent blizzards.

b639b6bf-353d-4787-8383-68b6da559014.name: The Sunken Vessel

dna.looks: A massive, elongated, cylindrical alien vessel is partially submerged in snow drifts across a desolate, frozen landscape. The vessel's hull appears heavily oxidized and encrusted with ice, displaying a weathered, metallic texture. Several circular indentations and raised sections are visible on its surface, suggesting complex alien architecture. A large, arched opening on the vessel's side emits a strong, fiery orange light, serving as the primary focal point. The scene is dominated by the sheer scale of the wreckage against the vast, featureless expanse.
dna.colorsAndLighting: The scene is illuminated by a cool, diffused light emanating from the sky, casting soft shadows. This ambient light is dramatically contrasted by the intense, warm orange glow radiating from an opening in the vessel. The contrast between the cold, desaturated environment and the hot, vibrant interior light creates a striking visual tension.
dna.atmosphere: A thick, pervasive mist or fog hangs in the air, obscuring distant details and creating a sense of isolation. The air appears clear in the immediate vicinity of the vessel but fades into a uniform haze further out. The overall impression is one of extreme cold and stillness, with the mist amplifying the feeling of mystery.
dna.materials: The primary material is heavily oxidized, weathered metal forming the vessel's hull. This is contrasted by the pervasive presence of snow and ice, which cling to and partially conceal the structure.
dna.mood: Mysterious, intriguing, and slightly ominous. The immense scale of the wreckage and the stark contrast in lighting evoke a sense of discovery and potential danger.
dna.sounds: Wind hissing, snow shifting, faint metallic groans, muffled echoes from within, a low, resonant hum.
dna.spatialLayout: The foreground is characterized by undulating snowdrifts and tire tracks suggesting a path leading towards the vessel. The midground is dominated by the immense, partially buried alien vessel, which stretches horizontally across the scene and recedes into the background. The background is an undifferentiated expanse of mist and snow, offering no discernible landmarks or depth.
dna.palette_bias: high contrast, desaturated primary with vibrant accent
dna.soundscape_base: quiet, atmospheric, with subtle mechanical undertones

navigableElements.description: Large, arched opening in the vessel emitting intense orange light

dominantElements: Massive, oxidized alien vessel (extends across midground and background)
Snow drifts (foreground and obscuring vessel base)
Fiery orange interior light (visible through vessel opening, midground)
uniqueIdentifiers: Intense internal orange glow emanating from vessel
b639b6bf-353d-4787-8383-68b6da559014.searchDesc: [Location - Exterior] Alien wreckage on frozen tundra. Has: arched opening (midground, center)

niche-1763500389107-i0hyg4jlu.name: interior of The Sunken Vessel

dna.looks: The immense cavernous interior is dominated by vast, interlocking panels of verdigris-stained oxidized alloys, forming walls that curve into a colossal, segmented dome overhead. Towering, rib-like support structures ascend from the walls, converging towards the distant ceiling, interspersed with dark openings leading into deeper vessel sections. Jagged floor plates and scattered debris litter the foreground.
dna.colorsAndLighting: A pervasive, low-intensity fiery orange glow emanates from recessed fixtures and etched wall patterns, casting a warm but eerie light that refracts through crystalline ice formations. Dominant grays of the metal are accented by the orange and amber luminescence.
dna.atmosphere: The air feels still and heavy, thick with fine dust and the faint scent of ancient metal and cold. The overwhelming scale and diffused light create a profound sense of depth and mystery, hinting at the vessel's lost purpose and immense history.
dna.materials: Primary materials are deeply oxidized, verdigris-stained alloys with a pitted, weathered finish, forming walls, floor plates, and structural supports. Crystalline ice formations cling to the upper reaches, contrasting with the dark, fractured metal.
dna.mood: Mysterious and intriguing, with an undercurrent of awe at the immense scale and a touch of ominousness due to the unknown nature of the vessel and its remnants.
dna.sounds: Distant drips, low hum, faint crackling ice, echoed stillness.
dna.spatialLayout: A vast, cavernous chamber with a high, domed ceiling and a vanishing point at immense distance. Entryways are through irregularly shaped openings and a prominent ramp in the foreground, with towering structural elements defining the midground.
dna.primary_surfaces: Oxidized, verdigris-stained alloy walls, floors, and ceiling segments.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Crystalline ice formations, alien debris fragments.
dna.accent_features: Recessed orange light fixtures, pulsing orange ramp lights, etched geometric patterns with amber luminescence, heat-haze effect in a portal.
dna.secondary: Fiery orange (lighting, recessed fixtures, ramp illumination)
dna.cultural_tone: An ancient, technologically advanced civilization, with a purpose and aesthetic beyond human comprehension.
dna.materials_base: Heavily weathered and oxidized metals, crystalline structures.
dna.palette_bias: Muted industrial tones with warm, low-intensity accent lighting.

niche-1763500389107-i0hyg4jlu.description: A vast, cavernous chamber within an alien vessel, characterized by oxidized metallic walls, colossal ribbed structures, and an immense, ice-laden dome.

navigableElements.description: A narrow, steeply inclined ramp constructed from oxidized alloy, ascending into the midground, softly illuminated by pulsing orange lights.
A large, irregularly shaped opening leading into a darker section of the vessel, displaying a shimmering heat-haze effect.
Large, irregularly shaped openings leading into deeper, darker sections of the vessel.
